title: Reconnect fallback owed during an in-flight /api/state request is lost when the EventSource is recreated
outcome: A fallback state poll that is owed while its /api/state request is in flight survives recreation of the EventSource. The recreated transport re-arms the poll instead of inheriting no deadline. A behavioural test recreates the stream while the fallback fetch is pending, leaves the replacement CONNECTING without an error, and observes the next fallback request.
acceptance: Reconnect fallback owed during an in-flight /api/state request is lost when the EventSource is recreated is done
